question_text: The list of requirements, along with the budget estimates, _____ reviewed by the board.
explanation: B. was. Subjek utamanya 'the list' (tunggal), jadi passive-nya 'was reviewed'. Frasa 'along with the budget estimates' cuma sisipan yang nggak mengubah jumlah subjek. 'were' jamak, 'have' dan 'has' nggak cocok untuk passive 'reviewed' di sini.

question_text: Each of the applicants _____ required to submit two letters of recommendation.
explanation: C. is. 'Each of' selalu diikuti verb tunggal karena fokusnya tiap individu, bukan kelompok. 'are', 'were', dan 'have' semuanya jamak, salah untuk pola 'each of + plural noun'.

question_text: The number of students enrolling _____ grown steadily over the past decade.
explanation: A. has. 'The number of' berarti 'jumlah' (satu angka) jadi tunggal, maka 'has grown'. Hati-hati: beda dengan 'a number of' yang artinya 'sejumlah' dan bersifat jamak. Ini jebakan klasik TOEFL.

question_text: A number of issues _____ been raised during the meeting.
explanation: B. have. 'A number of' artinya 'sejumlah' (banyak item) jadi jamak, maka 'have been raised'. Jangan tertukar dengan 'the number of' yang tunggal. 'Of issues' di sini justru penanda jamak.

question_text: Neither the coach nor the players _____ willing to accept the decision.
explanation: B. were. Aturan 'neither...nor': verb mengikuti subjek TERDEKAT, yaitu 'the players' (jamak), jadi 'were willing'. 'was' dan 'is' tunggal, sedangkan 'has' nggak cocok dengan 'willing'.

question_text: Rarely _____ such a dedicated team of volunteers.
explanation: B. have we seen. Keterangan negatif 'Rarely' di awal kalimat memicu INVERSION: subjek dan aux dibalik jadi 'have we seen'. Opsi A dan C tanpa inversion, D 'did we saw' salah bentuk (double past).

question_text: Under no circumstances _____ leave the laboratory without permission.
explanation: B. should you. 'Under no circumstances' adalah frasa negatif di awal, maka terjadi inversion: 'should you leave'. 'You should' benar secara grammar tapi urutannya salah karena inversion. 'Will you to' double form, salah.

question_text: Not until the final chapter _____ the reader fully understand the plot.
explanation: A. does. Pola 'Not until X' memicu inversion: 'the reader' subjek tunggal, jadi aux 'does' ditambah verb dasar 'understand'. 'do' untuk subjek jamak, 'has' dan 'will' nggak cocok dengan 'understand'.

question_text: No sooner had the train departed _____ the passengers realized they had left their bags behind.
explanation: A. than. Pasangan tetap 'No sooner ... than': begitu kereta berangkat, penumpang sadar. 'when', 'that', dan 'then' bukan pasangan yang benar untuk pola ini.

question_text: Scarcely had she begun her speech _____ the microphone stopped working.
explanation: A. when. Pasangan tetap 'Scarcely ... when': baru mulai pidato, mic langsung mati. 'than' dipakai untuk 'no sooner', jadi nggak bisa dipakai di sini.

question_text: The committee recommended that the proposal _____ before the next meeting.
explanation: A. be discussed. Verb 'recommended that' menuntut SUBJUNCTIVE: verb bentuk dasar 'be discussed', bukan 'is' atau 'was'. Subjunctive nggak berubah bentuk meski subjeknya tunggal.

question_text: It is essential that every participant _____ arrive on time.
explanation: B. arrive. Ekspresi 'It is essential that' menuntut subjunctive, jadi verb bentuk dasar 'arrive', bukan 'arrives'. Bentuk subjunctive selalu tanpa -s, ini aturan klasik TOEFL.

question_text: The manager insisted that the report _____ completed by Friday.
explanation: A. be. 'Insisted that' menuntut subjunctive: 'the report be completed', bukan 'is' atau 'was completed'. Verb 'insist' termasuk kelompok kata yang selalu diikuti subjunctive bare form.

question_text: It was not until the 1950s _____ color television became widely available.
explanation: B. that. Pola tetap 'It was not until X that Y'. Banyak yang tergoda memilih 'when', tapi pola ini Wajib 'that'. Ini struktur favorit soal TOEFL.

question_text: The more you practice, _____ you become.
explanation: A. the more fluent. Pola 'the + comparative, the + comparative' untuk hubungan sebab-akibat: makin sering latihan, makin lancar. 'More fluent' tanpa 'the' nggak valid di pola ini.

question_text: So convincing was her argument _____ everyone agreed immediately.
explanation: A. that. Pola 'So + adjective + was ... that': argumennya begitu meyakinkan sampai semua langsung setuju. 'because' ngasih alasan, tapi pola ini menuntut 'that'.

question_text: The proposal, having been revised several times, _____ finally approved.
explanation: A. was. Klausa 'having been revised' adalah reduced relative clause (sisipan). Subjek utamanya 'the proposal' (tunggal), jadi 'was finally approved'. 'were' jamak, 'being' dan 'to be' bukan verb utama.

question_text: The committee members, exhausted after the long session, _____ unable to reach a decision.
explanation: B. were. Subjek utamanya 'the committee members' (jamak), jadi 'were unable'. Sisipan 'exhausted after the long session' nggak mengubah jumlah subjek. 'was' dan 'is' tunggal, 'being' bukan verb utama.

question_text: If she _____ earlier, she would have caught the train.
explanation: A. had left. Ini conditional type 3 (masa lalu): 'If + past perfect, would have + V3'. 'had left' memberi makna 'andai tadi berangkat lebih awal'. Opsi lain nggak cocok dengan 'would have caught'.

question_text: I wish I _____ more time to prepare for the exam.
explanation: A. had. 'Wish' tentang situasi sekarang menuntut past tense: 'I wish I had more time'. 'have' untuk sekarang, 'would' dan 'will have' nggak dipakai dalam pola wish tentang kenyataan.

question_text: By next year, the company _____ its operations to three new cities.
explanation: A. will have expanded. 'By + waktu di masa depan' menuntut FUTURE PERFECT: 'will have expanded'. Artinya aksi selesai sebelum tahun depan. Opsi lain nggak menangkap 'by' di masa depan.

question_text: The students are accustomed to _____ in groups.
explanation: B. working. 'Accustomed to' memakai 'to' sebagai PREPOSITION, jadi diikuti gerund 'working', bukan infinitive. 'work', 'works', dan 'worked' salah bentuk untuk pola ini.

question_text: She is capable of _____ the project on her own.
explanation: B. managing. Pola 'capable of + gerund': 'managing'. Kata 'of' adalah preposition, jadi verb harus -ing. 'manage', 'manages', dan 'managed' nggak bisa langsung setelah 'of'.

question_text: The professor prevented the students from _____ the building.
explanation: B. entering. Pola 'prevent someone from + gerund': 'from entering'. Setelah preposition 'from' selalu gerund. 'enter' dan 'to enter' infinitive, 'entered' past, semuanya salah.

question_text: The lecture was both informative _____ entertaining.
explanation: A. and. Pasangan tetap 'both ... and': kuliahnya informatif dan menghibur. 'or' untuk pilihan, 'but' dan 'yet' untuk kontras, nggak cocok dengan 'both'.

question_text: The results were not only disappointing _____ unexpected.
explanation: A. but also. Pasangan tetap 'not only ... but also'. Hasilnya mengecewakan dan juga tak terduga. 'and', 'or', dan 'so' nggak membentuk pasangan yang benar dengan 'not only'.

question_text: He decided to spend the money _____ to save it for later.
explanation: A. rather than. 'Rather than + bare infinitive' artinya 'daripada': lebih baik menghabiskan uang daripada menabung. 'instead' butuh 'of' (instead of saving), 'than' sendirian nggak lengkap.

question_text: Despite _____ very tired, she finished the race.
explanation: A. being. 'Despite' adalah preposition, jadi diikuti gerund 'being', bukan infinitive. 'was' butuh subjek sendiri, 'be' dan 'to be' nggak cocok setelah preposition.

question_text: The mountains, whose peaks _____ covered in snow, looked magnificent.
explanation: A. were. 'Whose peaks' (puncak-puncaknya, jamak) menjadi subjek klausa sisipan, jadi 'were covered'. 'was' dan 'is' tunggal, 'being' bukan verb utama. Sisipan relatif nggak mengubah subjek kalimat utama.

question_text: _____ the heavy rain, the outdoor concert continued as planned.
explanation: A. Despite. 'Despite + noun phrase' ('the heavy rain') artinya meskipun hujan deras. 'Although' harus diikuti klausa penuh (subjek + verb), 'Because' memberi alasan yang justru kebalikan, 'Unless' nggak masuk akal.

question_text: The word 'mitigate' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: B. to lessen. 'Mitigate' artinya mengurangi dampak buruk. 'To worsen' kebalikannya, sedangkan 'ignore' dan 'emphasize' nggak ada hubungannya dengan mengurangi.

question_text: The word 'obsolete' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: B. out of date. 'Obsolete' = nggak dipakai lagi karena sudah ketinggalan zaman. 'Modern' justru kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'ubiquitous' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: B. found everywhere. 'Ubiquitous' = ada di mana-mana. 'Rare' kebalikannya, 'unexpected' dan 'harmful' nggak nyambung.

question_text: The word 'ambiguous' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: B. unclear. 'Ambiguous' = maknanya ganda, bisa ditafsirkan beda-beda, jadi nggak jelas. 'Clear' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'concise' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. brief. 'Concise' = ringkas dan padat, nggak bertele-tele. 'Wordy' dan 'lengthy' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'detrimental' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: B. harmful. 'Detrimental' = merugikan atau merusak. 'Helpful' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'diverse' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. varied. 'Diverse' = beragam, macam-macam. 'Identical' dan 'limited' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'eliminate' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. to remove. 'Eliminate' = menyingkirkan atau membuang sepenuhnya. 'To add' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'enhance' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. to improve. 'Enhance' = meningkatkan atau memperbaiki. 'To worsen' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'feasible' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: B. practical. 'Feasible' = bisa dilaksanakan, masuk akal secara praktis. 'Impossible' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'genuine' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. authentic. 'Genuine' = asli, bukan tiruan. 'Imitation' justru artinya tiruan.

question_text: The word 'hypothetical' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. assumed. 'Hypothetical' = bersifat dugaan atau teori, belum terbukti. 'Proven' dan 'actual' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'inevitable' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. unavoidable. 'Inevitable' = nggak bisa dihindari, pasti terjadi. 'Preventable' dan 'optional' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'notorious' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. widely known for something bad. 'Notorious' = terkenal karena hal buruk. 'Highly respected' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'pragmatic' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. practical. 'Pragmatic' = realistis, ngandelin hal praktis daripada teori. 'Idealistic' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'reluctant' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. unwilling. 'Reluctant' = ogah-ogahan, enggan. 'Eager' = antusias, kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'resilient' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. able to recover quickly. 'Resilient' = tahan banting, cepat pulih. 'Easily damaged' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'scrutinize' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. to examine closely. 'Scrutinize' = memeriksa dengan teliti banget. 'To ignore completely' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'subsequent' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. following. 'Subsequent' = yang menyusul, setelahnya. 'Previous' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'sufficient' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. enough. 'Sufficient' = cukup. 'Scarce' = langka atau kurang.

question_text: The word 'tedious' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. boring. 'Tedious' = membosankan dan melelahkan karena lama atau monoton. 'Exciting' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'undermine' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. to weaken. 'Undermine' = melemahkan dari dalam atau merusak perlahan. 'To strengthen' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'vital' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. essential. 'Vital' = sangat penting, nggak bisa diabaikan. 'Optional' dan 'minor' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'candid' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. frank. 'Candid' = terus terang, jujur apa adanya. 'Secretive' kebalikannya.

question_text: The word 'imperative' is closest in meaning to:
explanation: A. absolutely necessary. 'Imperative' = sangat wajib, nggak bisa ditawar. 'Optional' kebalikannya.

passage: The history of coffee begins in the highlands of Ethiopia, where legend says a goat herder named Kaldi noticed his goats became unusually energetic after eating berries from a certain tree. The berries were roasted, ground, and brewed, and the drink spread across the Arabian Peninsula. By the 1500s, coffeehouses had appeared in cities such as Mecca and Cairo, serving as places for conversation, music, and business. Coffee reached Europe in the seventeenth century and quickly became a popular beverage. Some rulers distrusted coffeehouses, fearing they encouraged political discussion. Nevertheless, the drink's popularity continued to grow, and coffee cultivation expanded to colonies in Asia and the Americas.
question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Coffee spread from Ethiopia to become a popular drink around the world.
Kaldi was the first person to grow coffee in Africa.
Coffeehouses were forbidden in every country in Europe.
Coffee cultivation began in the Americas in the 1500s.
explanation: A. Ide utamanya perjalanan kopi: dari Ethiopia menyebar ke Jazirah Arab, Eropa, sampai Amerika. B, C, dan D terlalu spesifik atau bertentangan dengan isi teks, misalnya Kaldi menemukan bukan menanam, dan budidaya di Amerika terjadi belakangan.

options: They became unusually energetic after eating certain berries.
They refused to eat the berries from the tree.
They slept longer after drinking the brew.

explanation: A. Paragraf pertama jelas bilang kambingnya jadi 'unusually energetic' setelah makan buah beri. B, C, dan D nggak ada di teks.

options: coffee was popular and therefore profitable to grow.
goats ate all the coffee berries.
the Arabian Peninsula had no farmland.
explanation: A. Kalau kopi populer, otomatis permintaannya besar, jadi wajar dibudidayakan di koloni. Itu kesimpulan logis dari 'popularity continued to grow'. B, C, dan D nggak didukung teks.

passage: The Great Barrier Reef, stretching more than 2,300 kilometers along the coast of northeastern Australia, is the largest coral reef system on Earth. It is home to thousands of species of fish, mollusks, turtles, and seabirds. The reef is built by tiny animals called coral polyps, which produce a hard skeleton of calcium carbonate. These skeletons accumulate over centuries to form the reef structure. Coral polyps live in a partnership with microscopic algae that provide them with energy through photosynthesis. When ocean temperatures rise, the algae may leave the coral, causing it to lose its color and turn white, a process known as bleaching. Although coral can recover, severe or repeated bleaching can kill entire sections of the reef. Scientists warn that climate change is the greatest threat to the reef's future.
question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The Great Barrier Reef is threatened mainly by rising ocean temperatures.
Coral reefs are built only by seabirds and turtles.
The Great Barrier Reef is the smallest reef system in the world.
Scientists have discovered how to stop all coral bleaching.
explanation: A. Teks menjelaskan apa itu terumbu karang, lalu inti di akhir: kenaikan suhu dan perubahan iklim jadi ancaman terbesar. B, C, dan D bertentangan dengan teks.

explanation: A. Prosesnya: suhu naik, alga pergi, karang kehilangan warna jadi putih (bleaching). B, C, dan D nggak sesuai dengan penjelasan di teks.

passage: The first controlled flight in a powered aircraft was achieved by Orville and Wilbur Wright in 1903 on the windswept dunes of Kitty Hawk, North Carolina. The flight lasted only twelve seconds and covered about thirty-seven meters, but it proved that controlled, powered flight was possible. In the following years, the Wright brothers continued to refine their machines, improving stability and control. Their work inspired a wave of aviation pioneers across the world, each racing to build faster and safer aircraft. Within two decades, aircraft had evolved from fragile wood-and-fabric machines into metal airliners carrying passengers between continents. The rapid pace of change was driven by the demand for speed in both civilian and military use, and aviation soon transformed how people traveled, communicated, and fought.
question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The Wright brothers' first flight began a rapid evolution of aviation.
The Wright brothers invented the airplane after decades of military use.
Kitty Hawk was chosen because it had a large airport.
Powered flight remained impossible for twenty years.
explanation: A. Teks mulai dari penerbangan pertama Wright bersaudara lalu menceritakan evolusi pesawat yang cepat. B salah urutan, C nggak disebut, D kebalikan dari isi teks.

explanation: A. Kalimat kunci: 'it proved that controlled, powered flight was possible', itulah makna pentingnya. B baru terjadi belakangan, C dan D nggak sesuai dengan pesawat pertama yang dari kayu dan kain.

passage: Sleep is far more than a period of rest; it plays an essential role in how memories are formed and preserved. During deep sleep, the brain replays the experiences of the day, strengthening the connections between neurons. This process, called consolidation, helps transform fragile short-term memories into durable long-term ones. Studies show that people who sleep after learning a new skill tend to perform better than those who stay awake. The amount of sleep matters as well: both too little and too much sleep can interfere with memory. Researchers also note that a short nap of about twenty minutes can refresh attention, while longer naps may produce grogginess. For students, the practical advice is simple: after studying, a good night's sleep may be more valuable than an extra hour of review.
question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Sleep helps turn short-term memories into lasting ones.
All people need at least nine hours of sleep.
Napping is harmful to academic performance.
Memories are stored only during the day.
explanation: A. Inti teks: tidur penting untuk konsolidasi memori, mengubah memori jangka pendek jadi jangka panjang. B, C, dan D bertentangan atau nggak ada di teks.

passage: The Industrial Revolution, which began in Britain around the mid-eighteenth century, transformed economies that had been based on agriculture and handcrafts. New machines powered by steam allowed goods to be produced faster and more cheaply than ever before. Factories grew up near coal mines and rivers, and large numbers of people moved from rural villages to industrial cities in search of work. This urbanization changed society in fundamental ways: family life, housing, and daily routines were reshaped around the rhythm of the factory. Working conditions in the early factories were often harsh, with long hours and low pay, which eventually led to labor laws and the rise of trade unions. The revolution also accelerated the spread of railroads and steamships, shrinking distances and opening new markets around the world.
question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The Industrial Revolution reshaped economies, cities, and daily life.
Steam machines were invented only after 1900.
Factory workers in Britain were never organized.
The Industrial Revolution began in North America.
explanation: A. Teks merangkum dampak revolusi industri: ekonomi, urbanisasi, kondisi kerja, dan transportasi. B, C, dan D bertentangan dengan isi.

explanation: A. relating to the countryside. 'Rural villages' = desa di pedesaan, lawan dari 'industrial cities' yang disebut sesudahnya. Opsi lain nggak nyambung.

question_text: It can be inferred from the passage that early factory workers ...
options: faced difficult conditions that later improved through laws and unions.
received generous salaries from the first day.
explanation: A. Teks bilang kondisi awal keras ('harsh, with long hours and low pay') lalu 'eventually led to labor laws and the rise of trade unions', jadi kondisi membaik lewat hukum dan serikat. B kebalikan, C dan D salah.

question_text: Neither the director nor the committee members was informed about the change.
explanation: B. Aturan 'neither...nor': verb mengikuti subjek terdekat, yaitu 'the committee members' (jamak), jadi 'were informed', bukan 'was'. Agreement jamak-tunggal ini jebakan khas TOEFL.

question_text: The quality of the products have improved considerably this year.
explanation: B. Subjek utamanya 'the quality' (tunggal); 'of the products' cuma modifier, jadi 'has improved', bukan 'have'. Jebakannya: 'products' jamak bikin kelihatan harus 'have'.

question_text: She enjoys reading, to swim, and hiking on the weekends.
explanation: B. Paralelisme: 'reading' dan 'hiking' gerund, jadi yang tengah harus 'swimming', bukan 'to swim'. Rangkaian harus sejajar bentuknya.

question_text: The training teaches employees to communicate clearly, working in teams, and manage conflicts.
explanation: C. Paralelisme: 'to communicate' dan 'to manage' infinitive, jadi yang tengah harus 'to work in teams', bukan 'working'. Ketiganya harus sejajar.

question_text: Her and I are responsible for organizing the event.
explanation: A. 'Her and I' berfungsi sebagai subjek, jadi harus bentuk subjek 'She and I'. 'Her' adalah objek pronoun dan nggak bisa jadi subjek.

question_text: Every participant must bring their own laptop to the training.
explanation: B. Aturan klasik TOEFL: 'every participant' tunggal, jadi pronoun harus 'his or her', bukan 'their'. Ini jebakan pronoun agreement yang masih sering diujikan.

question_text: By the time we arrived at the theater, the play has already begun.
explanation: C. Sequence of tenses: 'arrived' (past) dan 'begun' terjadi lebih dulu, jadi harus past perfect 'had already begun'. 'Has' (present perfect) nggak cocok dengan konteks masa lalu.

question_text: She said that she will call me as soon as she arrives.
explanation: B. Reported speech: kalau pembicaranya lampau ('said'), verb-nya mundur jadi 'would call', bukan 'will call'. Ini aturan tense agreement dalam kalimat tidak langsung.

question_text: The new model is more better than the previous one.
explanation: B. Double comparative: 'better' sudah bentuk comparative, nggak boleh ditambah 'more'. Jadi 'is better', bukan 'is more better'.

question_text: He is the most friendliest person I have ever met.
explanation: A. Superlative ganda: 'friendliest' sudah bentuk superlative, nggak perlu 'the most'. Cukup 'the friendliest person'.

question_text: The professor, together with his research assistants, were presenting the findings.
explanation: C. Subjek utamanya 'the professor' (tunggal); 'together with his research assistants' cuma sisipan, jadi 'was presenting', bukan 'were'. Jebakannya: 'assistants' jamak di tengah.

question_text: She avoided to answer the difficult question during the interview.
explanation: B. Verb 'avoid' diikuti GERUND, bukan infinitive, jadi 'avoided answering', bukan 'avoided to answer'. Beberapa verb punya pola gerund wajib.

question_text: Despite of the bad weather, the outdoor event proceeded as planned.
explanation: A. 'Despite' nggak butuh 'of'. Yang benar 'Despite the bad weather'. Kalau mau pakai 'of', gunakan 'in spite of'.

question_text: The manager asked that each employee submits a weekly report.
explanation: C. 'Asked that' menuntut subjunctive, jadi verb bentuk dasar 'submit', bukan 'submits'. Subjunctive nggak menyesuaikan subjek.

question_text: If I was you, I would accept the job offer without hesitation.
explanation: A. Untuk situasi hipotetis gunakan 'were', bukan 'was': 'If I were you'. Ini subjunctive untuk kondisi yang nggak nyata.

question_text: One of the main reasons for the delay were technical issues.
explanation: C. Subjeknya 'one' (tunggal), jadi 'was technical issues'. 'Of the main reasons' cuma modifier jamak yang jadi jebakan.

question_text: The students, as well as the teacher, was surprised by the announcement.
options: The students, as well as the teacher,
explanation: B. Subjek utamanya 'the students' (jamak), jadi 'were surprised'. 'As well as the teacher' cuma sisipan yang nggak mengubah jumlah subjek.

question_text: She has been working on this project since three months.
explanation: C. 'Since' dipakai untuk titik waktu (since March), 'for' untuk durasi, jadi 'for three months'. Ini aturan preposisi waktu yang sering keliru.

question_text: The equipment are expensive to maintain.
explanation: B. 'Equipment' adalah uncountable noun yang selalu tunggal, jadi 'is expensive'. Kata yang terasa jamak begini sering bikin salah.

question_text: No sooner had he finished the exam when he realized he had made a mistake.
options: No sooner had he finished the exam
explanation: B. Pasangan tetap 'No sooner ... than'. 'When' nggak pernah dipakai setelah 'no sooner'; harus 'than he realized'.
